name: AltEase Image Alt Text Manager
author: Rutuja Patil

pratapvashi123.display_name: Pratap Patil - Walstar Technologies Pvt Ltd

sections.description:
AltEase Image Alt Text Manager helps WordPress users find images that are missing ALT text and add useful ALT descriptions directly from the WordPress admin.

The plugin scans images in your WordPress Media Library and identifies images that do not have ALT text.

It can generate ALT text suggestions using existing WordPress image information such as:

  • Image caption
  • Image title
  • Image filename

You can review and edit the suggested ALT text before saving it.

Features

  • Scan images in the WordPress Media Library.
  • See the total number of images.
  • See how many images have ALT text.
  • See how many images are missing ALT text.
  • Generate ALT text suggestions.
  • Edit ALT text before saving.
  • Save ALT text directly to WordPress image attachments.
  • Generate ALT text for multiple images.
  • Works with WordPress images regardless of which page builder is used.
  • Does not require an external AI service or API.

How It Works

  1. Open the plugin from the WordPress admin area.
  2. Scan your website images.
  3. Review images that are missing ALT text.
  4. Generate an ALT text suggestion.
  5. Edit the suggestion if necessary.
  6. Save the ALT text to the image.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPL-2.0-or-later license.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the altease-image-alt-text-manager folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open Image ALT Assistant from the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Scan your images and review images with missing ALT text.
  5. Generate, edit, and save ALT text as needed.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require an external AI service?

No. The plugin generates ALT text suggestions using information already available in WordPress, such as image captions, titles, and filenames.

Does this plugin work with Elementor?

Yes. The plugin works with WordPress image attachments and is not restricted to a specific page builder.

Can I edit the generated ALT text?

Yes. You can review and edit the suggested ALT text before saving it.

Does the plugin modify my original image files?

No. The plugin saves ALT text as WordPress attachment metadata and does not modify the original image file.

Can I generate ALT text for multiple images?

Yes. The plugin provides an option to generate ALT text for multiple images that are missing ALT text.
